question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for prompt text customization across root session config, per-agent overrides, bootstrap-aware prompts, and acknowledgement-only reset behavior?
rationale: The issue asks for a new compatibility-sensitive config surface that changes session-start semantics, and current code already has startupContext, bootstrap, and acknowledgement-only reset paths that could conflict with an ad hoc `resetPrompt` key.

options.title: Define one reset-start policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Narrow to prompt text only
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving current acknowledgement-only defaults and explicitly documenting bootstrap/current-time precedence.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep the hardcoded prompt for now and route customization into the broader reset greeting policy discussion before adding schema surface.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans reset command behavior, config compatibility, and the current reset-policy discussion where steipete was explicitly routed in the issue timeline.
